reviews.text: The director of this hospital used my beloved dog in animal testing. I will never forget it, no matter how many years pass.

The teachers and staff are all very nice and welcoming.
And the prices are reasonable.

We use this clinic five times a month for health checkups, chemotherapy, grooming, and vaccinations for our three dogs and cats.

The attached grooming service is very popular and reservations are essential.

The owner and doctor is from the local area, so we feel at ease. I think their polite and kind service policy is also evident in their staff.

For our dogs, we can get blood tests and health consultations done every two weeks when we get them groomed, which is very helpful.

However, the long waiting times are tiring, so I deducted a star.

An acquaintance gave a bad review. They suddenly brought a seriously ill cat from a distant hospital to this nearby clinic. It's understandable that they would be troubled if someone suddenly brought in an animal they haven't seen before.

This vet is incredibly skilled. They were able to handle things that other hospitals couldn't. It was too late for my dog, but they did their best to treat him until the very end. If I ever get another dog, I'll definitely ask them to treat him again.
The teacher will listen to you attentively and empathetically.

I apologize for giving this review without having used their animal hospital services, but I made a reservation three months ago to coincide with the month they offer a 30% discount on birthdays. However, I was recently told that the 30% birthday discount ended in July and the prices had changed. When I asked if it was still possible to use the discount even after making the reservation, I was coldly brushed off with a "it's written over there." While a 30% discount isn't a big deal, the prices have gone up, and the quality of the grooming varies each time, so I don't think I'll be going back.

I've used their services several times since initially requesting them as a pet hotel. The prices are reasonable, and they even take the dogs for walks. Since it's a hospital, it feels relatively safe, and most importantly, you can tell the staff are very fond of animals; they provide detailed updates on how my dog ​​is doing during their stay.

Even my somewhat difficult dog seems perfectly fine and has been well-behaved.

I find it very convenient that I can have my dog ​​vaccinated at the same time as boarding. Honestly, it's quite far from my home, but I think it's worth it.

A diagnosis was made immediately without any tests being performed. As a result, treatment was delayed. I was very disappointed that there was no serious approach to my pet's health. In the future, I hope that necessary tests will be properly conducted before making a diagnosis.

This is my first time owning a dog, so I'm completely clueless, but I've been so grateful for the kind and helpful service I've received every time.

They even provided after-hours treatment for my dog's injury in an emergency, which was a huge help.

I hope to continue relying on them in the future.

This is the hospital where my beloved cat was cared for at the end. He was feeling unwell but the cause was unknown, so he was rushed from another hospital to be looked after here. He was admitted that same day and received excellent care in the ICU.
He was in a critical condition, so I am very grateful that you called us late at night and early in the morning, and stayed up all night to monitor his progress. At the end, the doctor and nurses saw him off outside as he crossed the Rainbow Bridge, and stood there in the heat bowing until we left. I think this is a wonderful hospital that cares for both animals and people.
Thank you so much.
I was shocked when I found out that the young, pretty woman I initially thought was the receptionist was actually the teacher.

I recently got a puppy, so I've made this clinic my regular.

The doctor is very kind and explains things carefully.

It's relatively quiet in the evenings, but it seems to be busy during opening hours. It's unfortunate that I can't get a grooming appointment easily.

PS
My dog ​​is now two years old, so I've started getting grooming appointments here too. I try to make appointments for several months in advance. Even though he's a Pomeranian, the prices are very reasonable!!

Everyone, including the nurses and groomers, is very nice!

PayPay is accepted. It seems like the waiting room can get crowded in the evenings with people picking up their pets for grooming. I think it's usually around 4:00 PM.

They're linked to my pet insurance, so I don't have to pay much out of pocket, which is helpful.
